interpretation: Shared CPU fusion alone materially lowers this fixed-midpoint arithmetic cost. This is not an integrated application speedup.

With the current mandatory independent-reference API, either fused-CPU or GPU qualification must also pay the original native reference generation; the measured full gated CPU pipeline is slower than native force alone.
The current reference-gated GPU total is its fresh reference plus positive GPU/API/commit overhead. A fast GPU kernel alone cannot establish application gain.
Any future reference policy change or application CPU fallback integration must be explicit and separately qualified; no prototype gate was dropped.
Native CPU6 is a source-equivalent reconstructed MFEM/callback/Boris probe, not the exact production binary phase. The actual CPU7 application phase remains a separate23.4ms baseline.

All cases use true captured self phi/unit psi and exact native selected frames/fraction/voltage. Field setup, file IO, resetting the fixed input and post-variant golden checks are excluded; per-pipeline required gates are charged.
Prepacked and AoS-pack+shared medians differ by less than1%; do not infer negative packing cost by subtraction.
